name: attrition_insights
description: Attrition intelligence brief for HR Business Partners, People leadership, and executive leaders. Generates daily (default) or weekly attrition analysis highlighting material changes, watch areas, and recommended actions. Supports HRBP Mode (operational detail), CPO/HR Leadership Mode (executive summary), and org-scoped mode for executive leaders (auto-detected). Triggers: attrition brief, attrition analysis, turnover report, regrettable exits, watch areas, voluntary attrition, involuntary attrition, attrition by org, attrition trend, upcoming exits. Do NOT use for: headcount counts or trends (use headcount_insights), a leader's full org health or performance outcomes (use org_health_report), or recruiting pipeline metrics (use good_morning_recruiting).
